competitors.name: Albertsons / Safeway
competitors.action: Supermarket News reported that Albertsons launched a Safeway plugin in ChatGPT that lets shoppers use natural-language requests to discover products, reorder favorites, shop from recipes or lists, build a cart and then check out through Safeway. For Real Dough, the signal is that grocery discovery is moving into AI-assisted meal planning, making complete product data and use-case language more important for premium frozen items.

competitors.name: Sprouts Farmers Market
competitors.action: Sprouts said its first-half affordability test improved unit movement but produced a slower traffic response than expected, and management is refining assortment, price and personalization tactics for the second half. Healthy meal solutions and private-label healthy essentials are gaining traction, including seed oil-free potatoes that management described as a top category seller.

competitors.name: Grocery retailers / GLP-1 shoppers
competitors.action: Supermarket News cited Numerator data showing 22% of U.S. households now have a current GLP-1 user, double the October 2023 adoption rate, and that GLP-1 households account for more than $660 billion in CPG, general merchandise and quick-service restaurant spending. After one year, grocery spending among comparable GLP-1 households was down 3.8%, with baskets shifting away from carb-centric center-store items toward fresh protein, seafood, functional nutrition and intentional snacking.

trends.context: Premium frozen brands need product pages and retailer feeds that can answer meal-use, dietary, availability and value questions without a human browsing the aisle.
